defaultValue: These decide what the filter panel's toggles start at, and what [Reset filters] puts them back to. Changing one here applies it to the open picker right away; your other filters are left alone.

fieldDescription: Hides hull-mods that can never go on the ship being refitted (a carrier mod on a hull with no bays). Turn this off if you would rather always see the full list.
Starts the picker showing only the hull-mods you have favourited. Holding [`] (backtick) does this momentarily regardless of the setting.
Starts the picker with hidden (blacklisted) hull-mods revealed instead of filtered out. Holding [Alt] does this momentarily regardless of the setting.

fieldName: Also search descriptions - on by default
fieldDescription: Widens the search box to match each hull-mod's description text, not just its name and design type.
Colour of the outline drawn around the filter panel and the [Name groups] window. The default matches the panel's original light blue.
How solid the filter panel's black background is. [0] is fully transparent, [1] is fully opaque.

defaultValue: Your favourites, hidden hull-mods, custom-group membership and group names are stored once per installation, in [saves/common/hullmods_renewed/], so they carry over to every playthrough. Marks for hull-mods you have not learned yet - or that belong to a mod you have disabled - are kept as-is and start working again as soon as those mods show up.

fieldDescription: Turn this on and press [Apply] to erase everything above - all favourites, hidden hull-mods, custom groups and group names - and start from an empty slate. This cannot be undone. The toggle resets itself to off once the wipe has run, so it will read as off again the next time you open this menu.
